The '''Gallapraxis [[Star system/Legends|system]]''' in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] was controlled by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Drex]], until he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
